title: Offensive Security Engineer
description_short:
• In this role, you'll conduct offensive security testing against AI evaluation infrastructure and build agent-assisted red-teaming tools to evaluate frontier AI safely.
  • Attack evaluation sandboxes and test escape paths in containers and VMs.
  • Build and operate agent-assisted red-teaming harnesses for continuous testing.
  • Triage findings from agents, confirm vulnerabilities with exploits and run wider engagements.
  • Collaborate with researchers on cyber ranges and publish your security work.

title: Associate, Development and External Relations
description_short:
• In this role, you'll support ARI's development work across ARI, CRI, and ARI PAC by managing fundraising operations, databases, and compliance.
  • Maintain fundraising databases with accurate data entry and records across all organizations.
  • Support FEC and IRS compliance by maintaining donor documentation and flagging issues.
  • Draft donor communications and coordinate logistics for fundraising events.
  • Research prospective donors and develop prospect profiles for leadership.
  • Track donor relationships and philanthropic trends to prepare fundraising reports.
